verdict.rationale: This is a government tax portal for filing returns, making payments and responding to notices. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back user-defined automations is a workflow-platform capability outside this product's category. Scheduled payments and employee access levels are one-off transactional features, not automation definitions with version history or rollback, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
